articleTitle: Comprehensive State-of-the-Art of Vehicle-To-Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A vehicle is a means of transportation, such as a car, truck, or train, that is capable of moving people or goods from one place to another. Vehicles can be classified based on various factors, such as the type of fuel they use (e.g. gasoline, diesel, electricity), the number of wheels they have (e.g. two, four, six), and their intended use (e.g. passenger transportation). Vehicles may have connectors, such as plug sockets or fuel ports, that allow them to be connected to other devices or systems to form Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) technology. For example, an Electric Vehicle (EV) may have a charging port that allows it to be connected to an electric power source to recharge its batteries such Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) as one of the V2X forms. One of the challenges in charging EVs is the availability of charging infrastructure. In many places, there are relatively few public charging stations, which can make it difficult for EV owners to find a place to charge their vehicles when they are away from home. Additionally, charging an electric vehicle can take significantly longer time than filling up a gasoline-powered vehicle, which can be inconvenient for some drivers. In this review, the various topologies of V2X, connectors, charging challenges, and EV impact types on the grid are conducted.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Networks Based Optimal Control for Stabilizing Nonlinear System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The cart pole system (CPS) is a topic that has captured the interest of many academics, particularly control engineers, due to its nonlinear and underactuated characteristics. This paper proposes a control law to stabilize the system, using an optimal and intelligent controller such as LQRWFPI (Linear Quadratic Regulator with feedforward PI Controller) and supervised control with neural networks. A hybrid controller is introduced, combining the strengths of a neural controller improved with a LQRWFPI controller into a single system. An adaptive neuro-controller is trained offline to simulate the LQRWFPI controller, and then placed into the feedback loop where it continues to update its weights. The study achieves online adaptive control of a non-linear CPS using a Generalized Adaptive Linear Element (GADALINE), with the regularized LM algorithm utilized to train the linking weights of the neural controller offline, and the LSM algorithm used to train the ADALINE ANN online. The objective is to develop a quick and reliable neural network-based nonlinear controller for the CPS that can effectively handle disturbances, uncertainties, and nonlinearities that would cause other robust controllers to fail. Results demonstrate that the neural network controller can learn in real-time to mitigate disturbances and continue to operate the plant efficiently.

articleTitle: Phishing Website Detection Using a Hybrid Approach Based on Support Vector Machine and Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The Internet has become the most useable tool for people worldwide to communicate and transact business deals, transform money and many other daily activities that require the exchange of sensitive information. As a result, it has become a major platform for cybercrime. In addition, phishing is one of the most common threats faced by internet users. A great number of legitimate and phishing websites come across to the life every day. Therefore, effective methods must be found to deal with the detection and prevention of different types of phishing. Machine learning (ML) techniques have become very popular in phishing website detection by predicting whether a webpage is phishing or legitimate based on datasets obtained from previously extracted features from many other web pages. Thus, this study aims to introduce a phishing website detection approach that utilizes Support Vector Machine (SVM) combined with the Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm. In addition, the Deep Belief Network (DBN) is also considered to select the best features from the extracted features. The collected dataset contains 12,000 samples. The phishing Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) were retrieved from the PhishTank website, whereas the legitimate URLs were collected from the open datasets of the University of New Brunswick. The performance of the proposed approach was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score metrics. The proposed approach achieved an accuracy of 97.54% surpassing the traditional SVM model by a percentage of 9.58%, and achieved better results on all metrics used.

articleTitle: Classifying Esophageal Cancer Using a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Early diagnosis of esophageal cancer is critical for increasing the chances of successful treatment and reducing mortality rates. Traditional machine learning models for diagnosing esophageal lesions use previously collected data on specific local features, but these methods can be slow and computationally intensive. As a result, researchers are exploring alternative training platforms for deep learning models, including quantum computers. These computers can take advantage of the properties of quantum entanglement and superposition to solve complex problems.In this study, we propose a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Network using deep learning and supervised learning techniques in a quantum framework. Our focus is on classifying esophageal cancer to demonstrate the network’s capabilities. We trained a network of two qubits to learn the label of a given dataset and optimize circuit parameters to minimize error. The proposed Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Network showed high accuracy in classifying esophageal cancer.

articleTitle: Image Encryption using Modified RC4 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new method for image encryption based on a modified RC4 stream cipher algorithm that scrambles image pixels before applying the XOR encryption function. We compare the performance of the proposed modified RC4 algorithm with that of the standard RC4 algorithm by analyzing histograms, calculating the correlation coefficient between adjacent pixels, and measuring information entropy. The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the standard RC4 algorithm in terms of resistance to statistical attacks.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of DC-DC Buck Converter with Voltage Control Loop Using Genetic Algorithm with Different Objective Functions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper aims to tune the voltage controller of DC-DC buck converter system using genetic algorithm (GA) with different objective functions. The DC-DC buck converter system is supplied with constant voltage from renewable energy source. The objective functions applied to tune the voltage controller are integral square error (ISE), integral absolute error (IAE), integral time absolute error (ITAE), integral time square error (ITSE) and integral square time error (ISTE). The DC-DC buck converter system is tested through nonlinear model implemented in Matlab/Simulink. The obtained results of the nonlinear model and the results of the mathematical representation (model) of the system are compared. All objective functions give optimum values of controller gains. However, obtained results revealed that ITAE is the best objective function compared with the other objective functions. It provides the best overall results.

articleTitle: Transforming Relational Databases into OWL Ontology: Methods and Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In recent years, the amount of data has become steadily larger than it used to be, resulting in the emergence of so-called big data, which makes it very difficult to handle and query data stored in traditional database systems such as relational databases. This led to the need for ontology to simplify and facilitate compliance with data models and querying them both for humans to make them meaningful and for computers to make the process easier. This paper aims to review and discuss methods for mapping an immigrating relational database to OWL ontologies. The results showed that ontology is still unable to produce the data required by a single ontology mapping. Rather, each case needs different rules that can be combined in the future to make a better ontology model along with the help of artificial intelligence and data mining to collect the required data.

articleTitle: Classifying Leukemia through DNA Expression Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The development of Microarray technology has provided vast amounts of data in various fields, including a cancer database which plays a crucial role in cancer prediction and recognition. This database includes expression levels of thousands of genes from several samples; however, the primary challenge lies in the mismatch between the dimensions of genes and samples. To tackle this issue, Artificial Intelligence algorithms, data mining methods, and computer science technologies are used to reduce the dimensionality of the matrix containing the expression levels of genes. After this reduction step, cancer classification or recognition takes place. The present study focuses on the binary classification of leukemia cancer with the aim of enabling scientists to classify leukemia samples into two classes (Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia and Acute Myelocytic Leukemia) in more efficient and accurate manner. To achieve this objective, various feature selection methods were applied and compared, leading to the adoption of the best dimensionality reduction algorithm, resulting in the highest classification accuracy using the minimum number of genes (features).

articleTitle: A Proposed Method for Detecting Network Intrusion Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: NIDSs, known as network intrusion detection systems, are essential for protecting computer networks. Nonetheless, there are concerns about the sustainability and viability of current approaches for meeting the needs of modern networks. These issues are more specifically connected to the decreased detection accuracy and the increased human involvement needed. This paper introduces a new deep-learning intrusion detection method to address these problems. We use a deep learning method by creating a Deep Neural Network (DNN) model for detecting intrusions and training it using the NSLKDD Dataset. From the 41 features in the NSL-KDD Dataset, we only use 37 of the essential features in this work. We demonstrate from various studies that the deep learning approach has much potential for use in NIDs. In this paper, we show the efficiency of our method and compare it with previous studies in terms of precision, accuracy, recall, and f-measure values.

articleTitle: A Cloud Computing Model for Libyan Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Cloud computing is now changing the IT landscape and playing a significant economic role for companies that develop software. Users of educational resources now have more flexibility and access because of cloud computing. Students, faculty members, and support staff all use cloud computing in academic institutions. Internet-based computing, known as "Cloud Computing," allows users to share IT resources securely and efficiently. The use of cloud computing in universities has many benefits, such as access to files, e-mail, databases, educational resources, and search applications as requested by faculty, administrators, staff, and students at a university alike. Moreover, cloud computing significantly reduces the complexity and cost of IT in universities. This paper discusses cloud computing, its structures, types, and services it provides, and then examines the possibility of implementing cloud services in universities and discovers the various opportunities and benefits of cloud services. The paper presents a proposed model for cloud computing for Libyan universities, which was applied to the University of Benghazi and produced satisfactory results and facilitated a lot of university work. Through the application of the proposed model, effective management of the technological needs of the Libyan university has been achieved, such as connecting programs and providing a platform for development, data storage and computing.

articleTitle: Malware Analysis in Cyber Security based on Deep Learning; Recognition and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Cyber security in wireless communications can be an unwieldy subject, given the amount of malware that has been increasing rapidly in the last few years. This generates serious security problems for public agencies and the government institutions. In order to mitigate the influence of malware deployment and pervasiveness, new recent identification and classification algorithms for malware that adapt deep learning techniques are studied and figured out based on their features and behaviors. This study introduces a deep learning algorithm to identify different malware families. To implement the proposed approach, malware color-based images (RBG) are used directly. Then these malware images are identified and classified by considering the benefits of leveraged Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which have the ability to automatically extract those features. A challenging malware classification experiment using the MaleVis dataset confirms that the adapted model outperforms better functional classification compared to the traditional machine learning models and achieves very good accuracy based on the MaleVis dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Smart Traffic Light System with Libyan License Plate Recognition on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The primary purpose of conducting this research is to create, test, and apply a traffic light system based on traffic density that operates in real-time with red light violation detection and automatic Libyan license plate recognition. A group of infrared sensors positioned on each intersection roadway are used to measure traffic density. It uses radio frequency identification technology to prioritize emergency cars. The system detects red light violations using passive infrared sensors and then captures the violating vehicle image, then the image is handed to the automatic license plate recognition system which processes the image to localize the license plate region and recognize the digits and characters. The suggested traffic light system is designed and simulated using Verilog Hardware Description Language and tested on Cyclone IV GX field-programmable gate array. The automatic license plate recognition system is implemented using machine learning and image processing algorithms.

articleTitle: Stochastic Method and Sensitivity Analysis Assessments for Vehicle-to-Home Integration based on Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) as hotspot research are increasingly being used as alternative energy sources outside of transportation due to global variables like energy usage and environmental concerns. Gridable Electric Vehicle (GEV) is exploiting the opportunity for connecting EVs to the grid. EVs are now capable of contributing to addressing power limitations and acting as a reserve source of energy for the distribution grid in the Electric Vehicle Charging Facility (EVCF) to form Vehicle-to-Home (V2H). This paper is introduced to estimate impacts on the load for the uncertain behavior of EVs under domestic load after being sized using algorithms. Although, the integration of EVs provides an economical and environmental solution with a positive impact, however, it affects the power system when the uncertain number of EVs is provided as heavy duty. Sensitivity analysis has been considered in the study to investigate the expected changes in the system from the affected components.

articleTitle: Multiband Printed Monopole Antennas for Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Small printed monopole antennas are presented in this paper. The types of antennas are three-arm and spiral monopole antennas. The antennas are fed by microstrip line and printed on FR4 dielectric substrate with a thickness of 0.8mm and a dielectric constant of 4.5. The proposed antennas provide good return losses, omni-directional radiation patterns, and good efficiency. The three-arm monopole provides three resonances at 1.8, 2.4, and 3.6GHz, and the spiral monopole provides two resonances 2, 3.6GHz. these antennas cover LTE,WLAN, 5G, and UMTS applications. The 3-D electromagnetic solver of CST® is used to simulate the antennas. Fabrication and measurement of the three-arm monopole has been done. The measured and simulated results agree very well.

Author Keywords: Index Terms - Multiband printed monopole antenna

articleTitle: Improved Technique for Manufacturing of the Elasctic Air-Permeable Electromagnetic Radiation Absorbers Based on Foil
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The improved technique for manufacturing of the elastic air-permeable electromagnetic radiation absorbers based on foil fragments is proposed. The results of the computational and experimental substantiation of the proposed technique are presented. In the course of this justification, the following has been performed: 1) numerical simulation of the process of interaction of electromagnetic radiation in the microwave range with aluminum and copper foil, depending on the thickness of the metal layer of such materials; 2) measuring of the electromagnetic radiation reflection and transmission coefficients values in the microwave range of the absorbers manufactured in accordance with the proposed technique; 3) calculation of the electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient values in the microwave range of the absorbers manufactured in accordance with the proposed technique. Based on the justification results, it was found that for the manufacture of absorbers in accordance with the proposed technique, it is optimal to use foil with a metal layer thickness of 50.0 μm. Electromagnetic radiation reflection and transmission coefficients values in the frequency range of 0.7–17.0 GHz of such absorbers vary accordingly within the following limits: 1) from –0.5 to –15.0 dB and from –5.0 to –25.0 dB, if the foil fragments cover 80.0 % of the absorbers surface area; 2) from –0.5 to –10.0 dB and from –5.0 to –30.0 dB, if the foil fragments cover 95.0% of the absorber surface area. Electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient values in the frequency range of 0.7–17.0 GHz of the absorbers manufactured in accordance with the proposed technique reach 0.9. Such absorbers are recommended for use in order to reduce interference introduced into the operation of antenna systems or electronic devices.

articleTitle: A simple Design of Automatic Bag Valve Mask Ventilator using arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents a ventilator that is characterized by simple construction and operation, as well as accurate execution of tasks due to the control system based on the Arduino board and servo motor. The device presented in this research is composed of two main parts: the mechanical part, represented by pliers, which are two opposite plates that can be moved at a specific angle and speed with the assistance of a servo motor connected to these two pliers by two iron rods, and the electronic part, which serves as the base for the ventilator described in this paper. The electronic component consists of a keypad, an Arduino board, and a servo motor. a display screen that shows the user-entered settings is also included. The main goal of this paper is to accurately adjust the amount of oxygen flowing to the patient through the ability of this device to determine the angle of the motor, and the number of breathing times that can be adjusted by adjusting the speed of the engine. A model of the proposed ventilator has been implemented and successfully tested in terms of modifying the motor angle and how rapidly the bag is pressed (motor speed). wherever the control system’s settings have all been accurately and completely applied. In comparison to other devices proposed in numerous studies, this device is characterized by the simplicity of its design, the affordability of its parts, as well as its light weight, which makes it easier to carry and move from one place to another. It is also distinguished by its accuracy in controlling the amount of oxygen required as well as the number of breathing cycles per minute.

articleTitle: A Novel High Gain Tri-Band Three-Dimensional Phased Array for 24/26/28 GHz Smartphone Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this manuscript, a three-dimensional phased-array antenna has been proposed for 5G smartphone applications at millimeter-wave spectrum. It consists of 4-subarray distributed on the four sides of the mobile phone’s mainboard. The suggested 3D phased-array shows a high capability to provide a full space coverage (360°) in the phi-plane, besides a 180°-half-space coverage in both elevation and azimuth plane. Each subarray is composed of 10 antenna-element where the antenna individual version is composed of a small fork-shaped antenna built on the RTRogers 5880 Duroid laminate, with 0.0009 low tangent loss, 2.2 permittivity, and full size of 5 x 6 x 0.8 mm<sup>3</sup>. The proposed phased array design exhibits a triple-band operation at the three prominent bands namely, 24 / 26 / 28 GHz with a total bandwidths of 197 / 506 / 600 MHz respectively. Furthermore, a high gain surpassing 16dB has been attained in the broadside direction with stable and uniform radiation pattern which is highly required for the transmission in the MMW range. The array performance has been carefully evaluated which assured its suit ability for the 5G portable devices.

articleTitle: Statistical study of optimizing preparation new SOFC anode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The current study focuses on the preparation of new perovskite materials as anodes for solid oxide fuel cells. Three sets of BaTiO<inf>3</inf>-MgO composites prepared by a low-cost mechanical milling technique were sintered at 1240 °C for 2 hours after being pelletized at a press force of 91 MPa and sintered with different molar percentages of MgO (0, 0.45, 0.85, and 1.85) mol% doped BaTiO<inf>3</inf>. The morphology of raw materials was evaluated using a laser particle size analyzer, and the mineralogical compositions of the produced anodes were assessed using an X-ray diffraction (XRD) apparatus. The physical characteristics were evaluated according to ASTM (C20-00, 2015). The morphology of an optimum electrode was studied by Vicker's hardness equipment. The MgO dopant influenced the high microhardnesses with high bulk density values and low porosity, which were further examined and compared to an undoped anode electrode using field electron scanning microscopy (FESEM). The analysis of variance was evaluated for Vickers microhardness Hv, P% and bulk density BD electrode. The findings of ANOVA highlighted the significance of these parameters and explored its effects separately.

articleTitle: A comparative study of two meta-heuristic techniques for solar PV systems under partially shaded conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: PV system is regarded as the most dependable source of energy because it is clean and environmentally friendly, but despite these qualities, it also faces challenges. As the output of the PV system is not constant, it depends on the position of the sun, and temperature, which is sufficient to place the system in partial shading conditions (PSC). Under these conditions, the photovoltaic (PV) system has one global peak and several local peaks. The traditional MPPT techniques are incapable of achieving global MPP. As a consequence, the goal of this work is to study the tracking performance of two meta-heuristic optimization techniques. They were designed to extract the GMPP from PV energy systems partially shaded. The two techniques are Crow Search Algorithm(CSA) and Flower Pollination Algorithm (FPA). To assess the effectiveness of the suggested two techniques, MATLAB simulation is used to investigate their performance under different PSCs. The results show that CSA and FPA-based trackers are capable of tracking global MPP with an average efficiency of 99.95%, and 99.98%, respectively, and an average tracking time of 0.19 s, and 0.25 s respectively for all tested conditions.

articleTitle: On-Rotor MEMS Sensor based Fault Diagnosis in Planetary Gearbox using Envelope Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The majority of rotating machinery is powered by planetary gearboxes. The early failure of a planetary gearbox and its’ resulting downtime have a significant negative impact on the dependability of the rotating machines. Subsequently, the safety precautions are well compromised which leads to the extreme fatalities and reduced productivity in industries. Identifying planetary gearbox faults at primeval stage is very crucial and difficult. However, it must be done to guarantee safety and dependability of the transmission system. Since, the gear meshing phenomenon is highly dependent on the carrier, it is frequently challenging to evaluate the condition of planetary gearboxes with the help of a traditional accelerometer. The revolutionary advancement of MEMS system enables MEMS accelerometer to be installed straight on rotating shafts, delivering more precise dynamic data of rotating equipment. This study relies on mounting a small MEMS accelerometer on the input shaft in order to assess the vibration signals produced by the gearbox. Then, envelope analysis is performed to determine the characteristic fault frequencies of the planetary gearbox. The findings indicate that the suggested method can successfully recognize the simulated defects, underlining the cost-effectiveness and trustworthiness of the proposed strategy in identification of planetary gearbox fault.

articleTitle: Design of 28/38 GHz Antenna Array With Improved Gain and Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, started with the design and simulation of a single element patch antenna which operates at 28 and 38 GHz bands for 5G applications. Slots have been introduced within the radiating element to attain dual band operation. To improve the gain and bandwidth of the array, the defective ground plane technique was used. Simulation were performed for important parameters such as return loss, bandwidth and gain, the obtained results satisfactory. For the purpose to get a high gain with improved bandwidth, parasitic element technique was used for the 1x4 antenna array. Simulation results, showed that the gain and bandwidth of the array antenna were highly improved.Comparison of simulated results were performed between the enhanced antenna array with other works available in the open literatures.

articleTitle: Fractal Antenna Design using Giuseppe Peano and Sierpinski Carpet for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This study presents a new fractal antenna design for multiband applications, which is made by applying Giuseppe Peano and Sierpinski carpet to the basic microstrip patch antenna. The Giuseppe Peano is applied to the patch edges while the Sierpinski carpet is created inside the patch area. The antenna is deposited on a 1.6-thick FR4 epoxy substrate with a dielectric constant of 4.4. The proposed antenna is created using the High-Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS). According to the simulation results, the fractal antenna resonates At seven resonant frequencies namely, 2.02 GHz (-24.43), 3.51 GHz (-16.46 dB), 3.88 GHz (-18.64 dB), 6.59 GHz (-21.42 dB), 7.32 GHz (-15.62 dB), 7.71 GHz (-35.63 dB), 8.05 GHz (-17.67 dB) with suitable radiation behavior.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control for the Satellite with the Influence of Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The sliding mode controller is a highly effective nonlinear control design approach that can enhance system performance and robustness. The core concept of this approach is to drive the state variables of the system toward a sliding surface that represents the desired location. This study focuses on designing a sliding mode controller to improve the tracking performance and achieve stability for the desired Euler angles (pitch, yaw, and roll) of a satellite. Nonlinear simulations are conducted to investigate the robustness of the sliding mode control design method under the influence of coupling due to pitch, yaw, and roll rates, as well as time delay through the feedback angles. The convergence of the rate of change of the Lyapunov function to zero is demonstrated to ensure system stability. The simulation results highlight the effectiveness of the sliding mode controller in suppressing the impact of time delay dynamics, in contrast to the classical proportional derivative control design approach, which results in instability. Overall, the study showcases the potential of the sliding mode controller to improve system performance and robustness in nonlinear control systems.

articleTitle: Calamity classification in satellite and drone images using CNN and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Every year, natural disasters strike, wreaking havoc on lives, property, and the environment forever. They are unstoppable phenomena. In recent years, remote sensing imaging analysis has become increasingly important for the purpose of identifying and monitoring natural disasters in the context of climate change and environmental surveillance. The ability to convey a large amount of information in a single piece while still capturing the status of the underlying ground is one advantage of aerial or satellite imaging. Remotely sensed imagery has become increasingly important for environmental and climate monitoring in recent years, particularly for the detection and management of natural disasters. Using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to better extract the catastrophe characteristic, we propose autonomous natural disaster identification in this paper. CNN is resistant to shadows and is able to accurately determine the characteristics of a disaster. It is also able to avoid operator error, which can have an impact on the efficiency of disaster relief efforts. The images used as the model’s training data are divided into four categories: floods, cyclones, wildfires, and earthquakes. The input for disaster detection is either a live video stream or a video that has already been recorded. The study demonstrated that transfer learning can be used to accurately recognize natural disasters. We hope that the findings of this study will lead to the creation of monitoring or surveillance systems that are capable of accurately recognizing natural disasters in real-time. Based on the encouraging results, the suggested method may contribute to our understanding of deep learning’s role in catastrophe detection.

articleTitle: Power Budget Calculation and Sensitivity Enhancement for N×25 Gbps TDM-PON Configuration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Passive Optical Network (PON) standards relied on Time Division Multiplexing (TDM) and Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) methods to maximize data rate. The latest 25GS-PON specifications were declared by Multi-Source Agreement (MSA) group in 2022. The current work stacks two and four 25-Gb/s TDM-PON downstream (DS) channels. The simulation, evaluation, and outcomes are completed using various versions of Opti.System software. O-band wavelength plan as well as Continuous-Wave (CW) laser with Non-Return-to-Zero/On-Off-Keying (NRZ-OOK) format support the system to mitigate Chromatic Dispersion (CD) and upgrade the system capacity. The power budget of 31.1 dB is suitable for Optical Distribution Network (ODN) standards, and the standard value of receiver sensitivity (-24.1 dBm) is achieved. The transmitted power of 1, 4, and 7 dBm are needed for 32, 64, and 128 users/λ, respectively. The transmission is successful for 512 subscribers and 20 km optical reach without the use of amplifiers, Forward Error Correction (FEC), and compensation techniques. The effect of four-wave mixing (FWM) is solved by the wavelength space of 0.8 nm as well as the slight increase in transmitted power from 7 to 7.8 dBm. The open and clear eye diagrams prove the quality of received signals. The simplicity of structure is high because of utilizing basic components and Intensity Modulation/Direct Detection (IM/DD) strategy without amplification and equalization. FEC and compensation techniques are recommended for future work.

articleTitle: Channel Gain in Micro-urban Environment Assisted Intelligent Reflecting Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The employment of smart mirrored surfaces or what are called intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRS) is one method for overcoming the radio environment’s poor propagation effects, particularly in the higher frequency range. Moreover, the electromagnetic waves used in wireless communications are generally scattered by surfaces and objects when they move from the sender to the receiver. Therefore, to describe these reflection phenomena and overcoming the radio environment’s poor propagation effects. In this research document, we incorporate the IRS based communication to enhance the transceiver communication links. Thus, we evaluate the benefits of IRS on channel gain in the Urban Micro environment for LOS and non-LoS channel components. Moreover, we examine the channel gain under several factors, such as the carrier frequency, distance and path loss factor. Furthermore, the channel gain is provided for both LoS and NLoS, with the latter being a function of all prior parameters. The numerical results for channel gain (dB) are supplied to validate our theorethecal equations.

articleTitle: Students Engagement in Blended Learning: Evidence from Moodle A Case Study from Engineering Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed significant and rapid developments in technological trends of teaching in educational institutions worldwide. We have seen online learning methods offering sufficient and effective solutions during 2020 and 2021. Although online learning had many merits, it did not offer a classroom-like environment. Blended learning has re-appeared as a good alternative that combines between the advantages of online and face-to-face (F2F) learning using learning management systems (LMS) like Moodle. In this paper, a series of Moodle reports were utilized to evaluate students’ performance and engagement in two blended engineering courses throughout four consecutive semesters. Results showed that the online part of the courses had about 110 views and 9 posts per student in all four semesters. This paper also presents findings on two formats of blended learning: (67% F2F and 33% online) and (50% F2F and 50% online). Results showed that there was a change in students’ engagement and studying behaviour between the two formats. Finally, students’ views and posts in the courses are compared against the timings at which midterm and final exams occurred.

articleTitle: SDM over FSO Link using 2um Laser Beam under Atmospheric Turbulences
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose and investigate the implementation of a hybrid space division multiplexing (SDM) - based free space optics (FSO) link using which independent information signals transmitted over distinct Laguerre Gaussian (LG) modes of a 2um-laser beam. The proposed link performance is investigated under the impact of geometric losses, laser beam divergence, transmitted optical power and receiver aperture diameter, and for varying atmospheric turbulences. Using simulations, we report feasible 4 × 10 Gbps information transmission over four distinct LG modes along 12 Km link range under clear weather and 5, 3, and 1 km link range under light, moderate and heavy fog conditions, respectively, with acceptable performance.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient 2D-DOA Based Precoding Approach for 5G Multicell Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This article presents an efficient downlink zeroforcing (ZF) precoding technique that utilizes the twoDimensional Direction of Arrival (2D-DOA) beam-spaced method to maximize the energy efficiency of multi-cell massive- MIMO systems. The approach for estimating the critical elevation and azimuth angles of detected signals from distributed sources in multi-cell massive-MIMO systems is also detailed. A mathematical model for energy efficiency of downlink ZF precoding is developed using these critical angles, and its performance is evaluated and compared to conventional 2D-DOA methods. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves energy efficiency with a gain of approximately 98.3% compared to the deterministic ZF precoding method.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of First Hop Redundancy Protocols in IPv4 and IPv6 Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: To enhance IP network availability, First Hop Redundancy Protocol (FHRP) is a necessary tool that used to achieve this goal. FHRPs are group of protocols that used to manage and maintain network first hop router (i.e. default router) failure. This work compares and evaluates different FHRPs which are Hot Standby Router Protocol (HSRP), Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol (VRRP), and Gateway Load Balancing (GLBP), in both IPv4 and IPv6 networks. The comparison among the three mentioned protocol was accomplished based on convergence time, packet loss and CPU utilization, after implementation, testing and optimization. GNS3 emulation tool was used. The comparison results highlights which protocol performed the best in each scenario and which protocol can be considered as the best among the three FHRPs.

articleTitle: Sizing and Locating of BESS-PV System Based Load Flow Analysis for the Integration into Al-Bayda City Medium Voltage Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources with energy storage systems becomes a necessity to improve the performance of the electric grid and to meet the growing demand for energy. The aim of this research is to find the optimal size and location of the associated battery energy storage-photovoltaic (BESS-PV) system for the medium voltage (MV) network of the city of Al-Bayda in order to improve the voltage and reduce the power losses. Firstly, three preselected sizes of BESS-PV system were tested to determine the best size. Secondly, working with the optimal determined size, the optimal locations among ten locations of MV stations that were selected as a case study, were determined. Through simulation based load flow analysis using a trial version of Power Transient Analyzer software, the two previous steps were performed. The main results of this study are that the optimal size of the battery energy storage system and the photovoltaic system was BESS = 1.5 MW and PV = 2 MW respectively, while the optimal stations evaluated with this optimal size were the AL-Riyadhya, AL-Shuela, AL-Muasalat, and AL-Edhaea, which contributed to improving the voltage and reducing losses more than the rest of the other stations.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Five Stages Piplined RISC Processor on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This research focuses on designing and implementing a processor with a five-stage pipeline for educational purposes. The proposed processor can execute five 16-bit instructions simultaneously and is designed and simulated using Verilog HDL. It is implemented on a Cyclone IV FPGA on the DE2i-150 design board. The processor is suitable for applications that require high processing speed and low power consumption, including mobile computers, consumer electronics, security systems, and more. This RISC-based processor has simple instructions that consume low power and execute quickly.

Author Keywords: The areas of expertise include designing processors using Pipelined RISC architecture
and creating FPGA designs using the Verilog hardware description language

articleTitle: Optimization and Influence of Tilt Angle on PV Module Performance: Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The aim of this experimental study is to optimize the tilt angle of solar photovoltaic (PV) panels installed in Al-Bayda city using various methods, which are generally classified into three categories; one variable method such as the latitude angle method and the declination angle method. The second category includes the clearness index method and the Kern and Harris method, which are based on NASA database specifically the solar radiation on a horizontal surface. Finally, the Liu and Jordan method and the Riendle method, which are based on isotropic and anisotropic geographical factor of tilted surface radiation. The experimental work was carried out at the laboratory of the Faculty of Engineering at Omar Al Mukhtar University, during the period July to November 2021. The tilt angle was varied from 0<sup>0</sup> to 60<sup>0</sup>. In the methods applied, the variances were limited to at least 10<sup>0</sup> for each month. It was found that the ideal tilt is 10<sup>0</sup> in the summer and 60<sup>0</sup> in the winter while the optimized annual slope is 30<sup>0</sup>. However, one of the contributions of this study is boosting the power output to more than 6% when varying the tilt angle monthly.

articleTitle: A compact patch coupler using cross-slots for 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A compact hybrid patch coupler operating at 3.5 GHz for fifth generation applications is presented. By introducing cross-slots with T-shaped heads on the edges, the proposed hybrid patch coupler’s overall size is reduced significantly. The proposed coupler offers a size reduction of 79% compared to the overall size occupied by a conventional reference design. Simulation results show a successful fit of the miniature coupler such that the reflection coefficient and the isolation values are −44.27 dB and −24.35 dB at 3.5 GHz. The insertion coefficient and coupling coefficient values are −3.18 dB and −3.88 dB for the same resonance frequency, with 30% fractional bandwidth (FBW) and 89° phase difference, showing that the cross-slot patch coupler is capable of diagonally coupling the input signal to its outputs at 3.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Using Brightness Distribution in Fundus Images to Automated Glaucoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Glaucoma is a condition of the optic system that can cause vision loss as a result of increased intraocular pressure. The disease is becoming more prevalent, and its diagnosis can be both costly and time-consuming. One prominent area of the retina affected by glaucoma is the optic nerve head, which undergoes structural changes. The goal of the study was to detect glaucoma by analyzing the brightness distribution in optic nerve head fundus images, with statistical parameters serving as the primary means of measurement. Specifically, the mean and standard deviation were extracted as features from the fundus images, representing the central tendency and variation of data within the images. The proposed approach demonstrated highly accurate results, outperforming existing literature in the field.

articleTitle: Modeling Directional Overcurrent Relays using Modelica
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Phase direction and over current elements are relied upon to provide fast and Reliable protection throughout the power system. Although directional relays have been successfully applied to many years, but the System disruptions present the most challenges. The directional relay model is implemented in the Modelica language in this study. The modules will be merged into the final relay model after being individually tested, and that model will then be put through several fault simulations. Thereafter, the results obtained from this model will be compared with other obtained from a previously prepared model using MATLAB. Finally, a sample power network was implemented in order to evaluate the relays performance in a system.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT): survey of most important security risks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The Internet of things (IoT) is getting more and more intrusive into our lives until the day comes when everything becomes connected to the Internet. Due to the limited resources and heterogeneous Internet of Things (IoT) devices, the traditional means of protection are useless and cannot be used to protect these devices. The most important security risks, their causes and the consequences of their occurrence have been listed, scheduled and categorized. The study concluded that there are real security risks that cannot be ignored, and they need to find innovative solutions to eliminate them or reduce their damage to a minimum. This paper showed the main risks addressed in previews research, and outlined the gaps in this field of technology, also producing a brief summary information about the most important solution to avoid many threats against the IoT field.

articleTitle: Microstrip Moisture Sensor for Wheat Grains Analysis and Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A multi-layered microstrip moisture sensor which is built an inexpensive microwave sensor for nondestructive and rapid sensing for particulate and granular materials to find of moisture content has been tested by using three types of wheat grains. The sensor was made from inexpensive material namely RT Duroid 5880, aluminum and plastic paper. The structure of the sensor consists of three layers namely grain layer, a protective layer, and a substrate layer. It designed by NI AWR Design Environment software at 9.2 GHz. The attenuation of wheat grain samples are measured by the sensor using network analyzer and compared with the results obtained from the software which is calculated using the dielectric mixture equation and dielectric properties measured by Open Ended Coaxial Probe. The data and graphs displayed a wide bandwidth of moisture content. This model is suitable for a range of moisture content of wheat grains as it could be validated in the range starting from 10% until 20.6% (wet basis) and attenuation ranging from 3.2 dB to 8.6 dB for three types of samples. It has been rated using conventional criteria, root mean square error (RMSE), standard error of performance (SEP) and correlation coefficient (R2). This microwave sensor prototype provides the analysis with acceptable accuracy.

articleTitle: In-depth Analysis of Interior Gateway Protocols in a Large-scale Enterprise Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Interior gateway protocols are among the routing protocols with the fastest expanding usage in networking technologies because they provide features that enable these algorithms to communicate together in a standard and flexible way. Network devices communicate through internal gateway protocols in autonomous systems (AS). This paper makes a contribution in this field using (Graphical Network Simulator) GNS3 version 2.2.34 software to simulate a ten-router setup to mimic a complex real-time enterprise-level network. Every protocol is put into practice using the intended topology.Methods/Statistical Analysis: The interior gateway, Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP), and Intermediate System to Intermediate System (IS-IS) are in-depth analyzed in a complex enterprise-level network, which made up to 30 multiple paths of routing data packets for each examined routing protocol, with consideration of link failure while employing various network scenarios.Results: End-to-end delay, jitter, and convergence time for each protocol have been measured for comparison in a large-scale (a complex enterprise) fixed topology. Finding the best practical interior gateway routing protocol is the study's main goal.

articleTitle: Performance of Power Allocation Under Priority User in CR-NOMA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A promising 5G communications technology was already known as CR-Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (CR- NOMA). Power allocation (PA) and user pairing both affect how well NOMA systems perform. For the PA problem, the majority of recent studies offer suboptimal solutions with high computing complexity that prioritize rate maximization over performance fairness. Furthermore, a thorough search is required for the combined optimization of PA and UP. The primary contribution of this paper is the suggestion of a brand-new, minimally difficult Maximization optimization Data rate based power allocation (MODRFPA) in downlink CR-NOMA. The combined effects of SNR per subcarrier and typically combined channel gains have been thoroughly analyzed and investigated. Users' feedback on NOMA's performance in terms of user fairness and capacity is demonstrated. The outcomes of the simulation demonstrate that the suggested MODRPA can enhance the fairness and data rate of current UP techniques. Additionally, simulation findings demonstrate that the proposed coefficient power performs schemes more effectively and offers performance that is close to ideal.

articleTitle: Investigation of Water Treatment Produced by Nanofiltration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper summarized nanofiltration (NF) studies which focused on treatment west water , this new technology has potential applications in treatment water process for getting fresh water usage which solved from organic and inorganic molecules enabling to reuse for various purpose . The NF membrane that used in this paper enabled to remove of up to 95% of total divalent ions and even surface water and make-up water consumption and . the permeability flux of water (J) as a function of influence pressure at different operation for the NF membrane which carried out on laboratory unit calculated which has strong form of the critical water flux exists when the flux up to a point is equivalent to the corresponding pure water flux at the same pressure. the relation between the permeate flux by measuring the collected permeate weight through the surface area of membrane as afunction of operating time course evaluated at different temperature and pressure . the permeate flux is going up along with increasing temperature and pressure.

articleTitle: New Avraging Technique to Reduce THD of Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Recently Multilevel inverter (MLI) have been attracting by researchers, they have been used in many fields such as high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission lines, industrial and renewable energies. This paper presents a design of a new technique to generate optimum pulses using an optimal pulse generator (PG) controller exactly averaging technique for three different topologies of a 5-level multilevel inverter flying capacitor (FC), natural point clamped (NPC) and cascaded H-bridge (CHB). A comparison is made between these three inverters types in terms of output AC voltage wave forms and total harmonic distortion for AC output voltage (THDv%). Consequently, this paper presents comparative results with some previous researches to prove that the optimal pulse generator controller averaging technique is one of the best methods to reduce (THDv%). To achieve the results a MATLAB SIMULINK is used.

articleTitle: Dual Band Circular Patch Antenna for GPS and WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a dual-band microstrip circular patch antenna for GPS and WiMAX applications. The dual-band circular patch antenna was created from a single-band conventional circular patch antenna after introducing slots to the circular patch and using defected partial ground plane structure. Simulation results show that the antenna radiates at 1.228 GHz , 3.32529 GHz and 3.553GHz with a return loss lower than -20 dB at these frequencies. Antenna gain at the resonating frequencies is 4.917 dBi 5.5 dBi, and 6.145 dBi respectively. The antenna is designed over Rogers RO4003C substrate and simulated using CST microwave studio.

articleTitle: The Role of Google Docs in Enhancing Collaborative Writing in Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Technology and teaching tools play a crucial role in enhancing the learning process, especially collaborative learning, in higher education institutions. This role has been supported by widely used online platforms and educational technology tools. These tools include Google Docs, a free cloud-based writing tool allowing teachers and students to create a virtual, interactive, and collaborative learning environment. The researchers in this article attempt to draw attention to the capabilities and uses of Google Docs and its role in enhancing blended learning in higher education institutions. Based on the review of the relevant literature on the effectiveness and usefulness of Google Docs integration, it was found that Google Docs was recognised as a valuable technical and collaborative tool to enhance collaborative writing in higher education institutions. Its features make it easier for users to work together on documents, resulting in more efficient and effective collaboration, improving the students' writing skills.

articleTitle: OwnBook: Developing Mobile Application For Badminton Court Booking System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: As a badminton lover, I decided to create a mobile application-based system based on the experience of the existing online booking system in order to solve the problem of booking badminton courts every time. The requirements of the majority of users are studied and the functionalities and pages of the OwnBook application are designed based on the total demand analysis through inquiry and research. To develop and implement this paper, Unified Modeling Language (UML), SQLite, Android Studio, and the JAVA programming language are used. The OwnBook badminton booking system will address the problems of the present system, allowing users to book badminton courts more easily.

articleTitle: Detection of Breast Tumor Using Microstrip Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper a new method will be used to detect breast cancer without affecting the human body. This will use a microstrip ring resonator operated at 2.4 GHz with supporting material for detecting of tumor based on measuring the resonance frequency, effective dielectric constant and then calculated dielectric constant.The breast phantom was designed and simulated in the form of a rectangle shape containing, Skin, Fat and Glandular, whereas the tumor is shaped as spherical with different radiuses.Simulation results was carried out using CST software, were the tumor was detected by resonance frequency and return loss by comparing between the healthy and affected breast. The results showed that, the tumor with size of 0.5mm radius was detected.Finally, this method was simplified by removing the support material and the simulation process is repeated again and it gave a close simulated results as with it.

articleTitle: Automatic recognition of GPR localized targets images using C3 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A near-surface geophysical technique with several uses is ground penetrating radar, often known as GPR, ground probing radar, or georadar. GPR has been utilized effectively over the past 30 years to aid with limiting issues in various domains, including environmental site characterization, archaeology, glaciology, etc. The electromagnetic signal produced by the GPR, a Non Destructive Testing (NDT) method, penetrates the subsurface and measures the amplitude and duration of the signal that is reflected back. GPR data may be used to create high-resolution cross-sections of the scanned material. After pre-processing the input GPR images, a special thresholding approach is employed to separate the regions of interest from background. The next step is to utilize a column connection clustering (C3) approach to divide the areas of interest from one another.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Learning Model for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Mammography is a technique for detecting breast cancer early and is able to reduce specific mortality rates. However, it is often difficult to accurately identify breast cancer through mammograms due to the difficulty of interpreting it, Therefore, early identification of breast cancer with mammography is an effective strategy for patients' survival rate. In this article, Based on the principles of deep neural network and machicne learning (ML) models will propose a new technique to precisely detect breast cancer. Firstly, Data collection and preprocessing of Images; second, Feature extraction by Visual Geometry Group (VGG-19); convolution neural network. In designing the proposed breast cancer detection system, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Neural Autoregressive Distribution Estimation (NADE) models, and hybrid of SVM and NADE models of ML are used for classification process. The experimental results showed that the above proposed method is very efficient for Binary classification and provides better accuracy.

articleTitle: Near-field Generation and Control in Radio Towers for DAB frequencies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper uses an existing method to simulate realistic electromagnetic fields found inside transmission pylons in DAB frequencies. The near-field generation is done by a combination of simple dipoles placed around a characterization volume. Generated near-fields are then compared to reference near-fields using different metrics. The comparison is performed using statistical tests. Resulting near-field data sets were then rated to find the best fitting near-fields, thus the most appropriate inputs for the near-field generator.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Adoption Model for SME E-Commerce Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Sales via e-commerce have become a must for companies, along with the increasing use of information technology by sellers and buyers to support sales transactions. Almost all retail companies use e-commerce to support the sale of their products, even many companies that only serve online sales via e-commerce. SMEs are businesses that use e-commerce to support their sales. However, the sale of SMEs via e-commerce is not in accordance with the specified sales target, so the adoption of e-commerce is not effective for SMEs. Machine learning is a technology that can help SMEs increase the effectiveness of selling via e-commerce. With machine learning, SMEs can increase the effectiveness of sales via e-commerce with the results of feature recommendations on SME e-commerce. Therefore, the goal of this research is to create a model of adaptation using machine learning for improving small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) online sales. A literature analysis is used as the basis for this study to determine the issues plaguing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and builds a machine learning adoption model for e-commerce based on previous research.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation of Islamic Banks using Business Process Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Organizational management that utilizes business processes has become of paramount importance to organizations to reach a high level of effectiveness and competitiveness by adopting an effective Business Process Management (BPM) model. This paper presents a business process management model in Islamic banks for digital conversion with a business process management system. The study is to clarify the role of technology in Islamic financing banks in the start-up phase, by proposing to work with the practice BPM system, designed for automating the business using technology. This is for facing the most serious administrative challenges in Islamic banks, with control over the most technical challenges. One of the stages of the model was implemented in the Libyan Islamic Bank and achieved encouraging results through which it is possible to continue applying the entire stages of the system to many Islamic banks operating in Libya.

articleTitle: Using Deep Learning Approaches for the Automatic Detection of COVID-19 and Assessing Disease Severity through Chest CXR and CT Scan Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The novel coronavirus has been rapidly spreading globally since its first appearance in China at the end of 2019 and has become a worldwide pandemic. Early detection and isolation of infected cases are major factor in decreasing the spread of the virus. The most popular and effective method for detecting the disease is RT-PCR, but it is expensive and time-consuming. Radiography is a diversty option for detecting the infected cases and determining its severity. However, this process requires experienced radiologists to manually interpret the images. This paper aims to evaluate the effectiveness of using DL models in the automatic classification of the COVID-19 and quantitative measurement of the severity of the spread of the virus in the lungs through CXR and CT scan image processing. Two models have been introduced, one specifically designed for processing CXR images using CNN and DL (Xcov_model), and another based on the structure of the first model but intended for processing CT scan images (CTcov_model). Both models were supported by the Grad-Cam algorithm to create a heat map indicating where the disease is expected to spread. The dataset consisted of 9000 images, which were evenly divided into three classes for both CXR and CT scans. 80% of these images were used for training and 20% for testing, in addition to the implementation of DA technology. The models were implemented and evaluated using Python on the Google Collaboratory platform, with the Xcov_model achieving an F1-Score of 98% for both the COVID-19 class and the normal class, and the CTcov_model having a test accuracy of about 98%.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation and Sizing of reactive sources in the medium voltage systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper the optimal size and location of capacitor banks for one of the medium voltage electrical networks in the existing southern region of the Libyan electrical network will be studied using Total Voltage Change Index (TVCI) method, and is calculated by summation of the mutual sensitivity values of a specific substation with respect to the other station, by using the Neplan program, to obtain an improvement for voltage profile and minimizing losses.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The definition of a brain tumor is the development of aberrant brain cells, some of which may progress to cancer. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans are the conventional technique for finding brain tumors. Applying Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL)-based algorithms to efficiently identify the existence of brain tumors from Magnetic Resonance Imaging scans is a more effective and reliable technique. Both Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms were utilized in this paper, and their performance was examined. A thorough comparison between the two approaches was also given. It takes extremely little time to forecast a brain tumor when these algorithms are applied to Magnetic Resonance Imaging pictures, and the better accuracy makes it easier to treat patients. The radiologist can make speedy decisions thanks to these projections.

articleTitle: Investigating EEG Connectivity Differences Between Right and Left-Handers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: An extensive knowledge of cognitive development from early infancy to late adolescence is required to investigate brain neural pathways. The success in recognizing diverse stimuli is one of the remarkable frameworks that used to examine the essential variations in cognitive processes. Recognizing the intended stimuli has been proven to be influenced by several factors such as participants ‘gender and handedness. In this study, we investigated whether these cognitive variations regarding handedness take place at age nine-year. 33-EEG channels were recorded while seven right-handed and seven left-handed participants completed the Eriksen Flanker task-experimental paradigm with a variety of stimuli for evaluating attention and cognition. In each handedness group, the imaginary coherence was computed to evaluate the functional connectivity of each child. It was observed that left and right-handers activate distinct cortical regions, particularly in the alpha and beta bands. Additionally, the findings showed that brain connectivity at the incongruent Flanker stimuli can be utilized to differentiate the two targeted group.

articleTitle: Detection of Communication Network Intruders Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Networks for communication are becoming more and more crucial to our society. They are consequently the focus of various malicious attacks that ultimately result in genuine intrusions. These systems require security against intrusion. There are several established methods for identifying intruders on a network; however, they all depend on rapid and accurate detection of the intruders and occasionally fall short. Therefore, using intelligent control instead of traditional methods to identify intruders may be more effective. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), one of the effective Intelligent Control Techniques (ICT), were used in the construction of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to enhance intruder detection and the security of communications network systems. Together with network simulator tools OPNET and data extraction methods WEKA.As a result, we collected network data from several sources, including MIT's KD99 database, and studied it locally and online. The data set is divided into two subsets: one for training and the other for testing. 30% of the data was utilized to analyze and test the system, while 70% was used to train the system. The performance criteria metrics, such as absolute percentage error (MAPE) and root mean square error (RMSE), are calculated to assess the model's applicability. The results show that the ANN model was effective in recognizing network intrusions

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of the Effect of Voltage Unbalance and Sinlge Phasing on Three Phase Induction Motor Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Balanced supply voltage enables three phase induction motors (IMs) to operate with high effectiveness and avert a reduction in their lifespan. However, when there is a presence of unbalanced voltage, utmost problems in these motors' performance will exist. Voltage unbalance occurs when there is an inequality in voltage magnitude and phase shift, while single phasing exists when one of the phases becomes open during motor operation. In this paper, we study the problem of voltage unbalance and single phasing and introduce its effect on the performance of three phase IMs using Matlab/Simulink. We consider three scenarios of voltage unbalance, namely unbalance in magnitude, unbalance in phase shift, and unbalance in magnitude and phase shift in addition to single phasing. A comparison between these scenarios is discussed. In this work, we apply the method of symmetrical components to derive the motor equivalent circuit and characteristics when operating under the above-mentioned scenarios. Simulation results show that the higher adverse impact on three phase IM characteristics is caused by the unbalance in magnitude and phase shift, followed by single phasing, the unbalance in phase shift only and the unbalance in magnitude only.

articleTitle: ADRC Robustness for Boiler Turbine Unit at Equilibrium Operation Point
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, control techniques for a Boiler-Turbine Unit (BTU) are presented. The BTU is a multivariable, nonlinear, and strongly coupled system, and the goal is to eliminate the impact of undesired signals by designing a controller that can accomplish this task. The proposed controller is called an active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC), which utilizes an extended state observer (ESO) to recognize the system's nonlinear components as disturbance terms and its unknown dynamics. By rejecting the defined disturbance, future controller design is simplified and the system is linearized. This results in a more straightforward controller design process that requires less system expertise. The ADRC is compared with an Anti-Windup controller, and simulation results demonstrate the robustness of the ADRC to adjustment points, internal, and external disturbances

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Encryption and Decryption Algorithm Based on Encrypted Hidden Private Key with Logical Shift and XOR Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper a new encryption and decryption algorithm using hidden encrypted private key with logical shift and XOR operations is introduced. The strength of this algorithm is depending on the use of encrypted and hidden key and the two logical operations. The main objective of using the encrypted hidden key in the cipher-text is to solve the problem of the private key distribution and to increase the security level provided by the proposed algorithm. The proposed algorithm is investigated on six text files of various sizes and compared with three other encryption algorithms. The obtained simulation results show that the main two advantages of the proposed method are represented in the computation simplicity and security efficiency compared with AES , DES and Triple DES algorithms.

articleTitle: Medium-Term Load Forecasting for The City of Benghazi Using an Artificial Neural Network Based Time Series Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In recent years, an increase in the electricity load at the General Electricity Company of Libya (GECOL) has led to power shortages during the peak summer season. And sometimes there was an acute shortage in the distribution of electricity throughout the country. Due to the interruption of large generation units or transmission lines of the electric power grid. this paper aims to address the issue of electrical load demand forecasting by using the NARX tool on the MATLAB platform to train artificial neural networks (ANN). The forecasting of Benghazi’s electricity consumption is the main topic of this paper. In this work, deep learning is used for the first time to forecast overall energy demand and consumption in Benghazi. The real data acquired by the National Control Center GECOL supports the results that were achieved.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized Bandpass Frequency Selective Surface with Dual-pand and Independent Polarization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The design of dual-band and dual-polarized miniaturized frequency selective surface (MEFSS) is described in this paper.
