The reactive components for reduce the unit cell and control the resonant frequency, symmetric geometry for independent polarization and interlaced shapes for dual band. Investigating the parameters of FSS design is done before presenting the final design. The proposed dual-band MEFSS provide two pass bands operating at 0.43GHz and 1.75GHz which is two interlaced crosses with reactive lumped components.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of a Two-Wheeled Robot Machine with a Handling Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The mathematical model of a two-wheeled robotic machine (TWRM) with five degrees of freedom (DOF) is utilized in this paper to enlarge the workspace and enhance the robot’s flexibility. The suggested machine features five degrees of freedom (DOFs), which makes it suitable for pick-and-place, material handling, and packing tasks in the workplace. The proposed architecture will make it more difficult to control the system to account for the center of mass’ (COM) location changing as a result of managing tasks that must be performed in multiple directions. The state space model was created by linearizing the non-linear modeling equations at the equilibrium point using the Lagrangian modeling. Numerous controllers, including the proportional-integral-derivative (PID), linear-quadratic regulator (LQR), and PID with LQR methods, were tested in order to stabilize the robot. The PID with LQR technique, where PID was used as a feedforward to control the intermediate body (IB) and end-effector and LQR was used as state feedback to regulate all states. These controllers were evaluated while taking into account a variety of circumstances (disturbance signals, tracking pathways, and moving actuators). In terms of least overshoot, rising time, and applied input forces, simulation results showed that PID with LQR controller tuned performed better than the other two control systems.

articleTitle: Quality Obstacles of Distance Learning: Experiences from Students of the University of Benghazi
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Adopting distance learning with a high level of quality in universities and educational institutions is a real challenge. Therefore, several studies and organizations have provided different standards to evaluate the quality of long-distance and to measure the obstacles. This study examines the quality obstacles of the long-distance learning techniques applied at the Faculty of Information Technology at the University of Benghazi, Libya. The British Quality Assurance Agency (BQAA) standards are utilized and presented as a questionnaire to the students at the faculty. The total participant number is 223 respondents. The study findings show that the students face severe challenges in all categories of the BQAA of technical, social, and organizational obstacles. The level of challenges is represented in the negativity of the response 69.1%, 60.1%, and 59.44% of the determined categories.

articleTitle: Broadband Printed Dipole Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Design, simulation, and measurement of printed dipole array antennas are presented. The dipole element is fed by a log-periodic microstrip balun. The balun converts the unbalanced microstrip line into a balanced two-wire line feeding the dipole. Two-element and four-element dipole arrays are designed by using Wilkinson power divider parallel feeding networks. The arrays are designed using an inexpensive FR4 dielectric material. The height of the dielectric substrate is 1.6mm and its dielectric constant is 4.5. The proposed antennas are simulated using CST MWS electromagnetic simulator. The simulated impedance bandwidths are 27.5%, 29.5%, and 28.6% whereas the realized gains are 4.2dB, 7.2 dB, and 9.7dB for the single element, two-element, and four-element designs respectively. The two-element array has been manufactured and tested. The simulated results agree well with the measured ones. The obtained bandwidths are 29.5% and 27.9% from simulation and measurement respectively. The centre frequency of the measurement result is slightly shifted up towards 2.15GHz. This is mainly due to the dielectric constant which is not well-defined and can take any value from 4 to 5.

articleTitle: Getting Smarter with Fatrix: A Facial Recognition Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The Library of private university has an RFID access control system. Such systems are popular door-entry solutions that can manage access in and within buildings and commercial properties. However, it has many security issues ranging from network and hardware attacks to loss of data integrity, privacy, and confidentiality. Besides, the system implements ID cards to store the confidential information of users and the cards can be stolen and misused by unauthorized users. In this paper a robust facial recognition access control system entitled FATRIX is proposed. The system can provide smart user authentication using facial features and machine learning algorithms plus data analytics to visualize the number of students in the building and the peak hours in which the highest number of students visit the library.

articleTitle: The effect of Al-Khaleej power plant on the power transfer & transient stability of the Libyan grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The complexity of power systems is rising, determining the limits of power flow and stability characteristics of a power system has become a significant concern. The behavior of an electrical power system under a sudden or sequence of disturbances when it is functioning in steady state is defined as power system stability .In this paper the effects of connecting Al-Khaleej Power plant into the Libyan national grid is investigated to determine the maximum power flow capability of the network for delivering power from the eastern side (Where power production is in abundance) to the western side (Where power demand is at its highest) and the transient stability is also performed on large-disturbance rotor angle, real power, voltage and frequency of the production units in Zwetina Power Plant.. The grid parameters evolution in time following a large disturbance is analyzed in brief. The Egyptian and Tunisian connection sides are not analyzed in this paper. Whereas load flow calculations and dynamic simulations are done. The load flow results show that maximum power transfer is achieved between both sides of the network when the two generating units were introduced to the active grid, followed by the introduction of one generating unit and lastly, the absence of the power plant provided the least maximum power transfer capability to the system. The Power system stability is analyzed in Zwetina Power plant and in 3 areas in the grid from each primary area: The western area, the eastern are and the southern area. Brega, Khoms switching & El Fjij were chosen respectively to be investigated in this study. Transient stability is maintained in the simulated scenarios and stability is more tuned and contains more timed oscillations in the case of the presence of both generating units in comparison to the model where the generating units were out of the network.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Inference Systems for Load Balancing of Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Wireless networks offer many benefits such as cost-effectiveness, flexibility, and convenience. However, they have challenges that can impact their performance and security, one of which is scalability. This research focuses on the scalability challenge, specifically on the user-Access point (AP) association process and load balancing technique, which ensures that devices are associated with the best AP for their current location and network conditions. This paper presents the development of Fuzzy Inference Systems (FIS) to address the load balancing problem using Mamdani and Sugeno models to examine their impact on the candidacy connection of the AP. In addition, the use of different membership functions on Mamdani-type fuzzy inference system are investigated to evaluate the suitability for subscriber to connect to the AP (i.e., AP’s candidacy of connection).

articleTitle: Decoupling of Compact MIMO Antennas Using Parasitic Element and Electromagnetic Band Gap Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: the main concerns with wireless communication are always the limitation of services in conjunction with vast demand of huge data transmissions. MIMO system provides large amount of data transmission by deploying multiple antennas at both transmitter and receiver, however, the limitation of this technique is the occurrence of mutual coupling among elements which deteriorates the system performance and can considerably affect both power and bandwidth efficiencies. Therefore, this paper studies and simulates various techniques for reducing the mutual coupling. Two element circular patch antennas are designed on a substrate made of Rogers RT5880 with dielectric constant (permittivity) of 2.2 and loss tangent of 0.0009. The size of the MIMO antenna is 30x 15 x 1.6 mm<sup>3</sup> with optimized space between radiating elements of 7 mm. Three techniques are used in this paper which are, defected ground structure (DGS), parasitic slab element and electromagnetic band gab (EBG) structure. All these techniques are simulated over the range between 20-80 GHz, the design provides mutual coupling reduction starts form -30 dB to -54 dB at different resonant frequencies with bandwidth reaches up to 30 GHz. The comparison between decoupling techniques shows slightly different in the performance which about -4dB for parasitic slab element and EBG. In this paper, the envelope correlation coefficient is simulated and resulting in roughly zero at resonant frequencies which indicates that the techniques of decoupling play a major role to reduce the effect of mutual coupling. All results are designed and simulated using CST MWS.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mobile Accelerometer Sensor Movement Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Currently, many mobile phones come equipped with sensors that enable the delivery of advanced features and services to users. One type of sensor that is commonly embedded in mobile phones is the accelerometer. By applying machine learning algorithms to analyze the movement patterns of a mobile device through its accelerometer data, valuable insights can be gained. This analysis can classify different types of movement, such as walking, running, or driving. These insights can be applied in various settings, such as providing better fitness tracking apps and developing new methods for user authentication. The purpose of this research is to explore and examine the movement patterns of mobile devices through the application of machine learning techniques to accelerometer sensor data.

articleTitle: Speed Control Of IPSMS Using Space Vector PWM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The permanent magnet synchronous motor is highly efficient and smaller in size compared to other motors. Therefore, this type of motor has recently been widely used in industry, especially in the field of electric transportation. Permanent magnets produce a constant flux linkage component, while excitation coils create a variable flux linkage. Excitation coils can either increase or decrease the permanent magnets flux, adding a further degree of freedom in the motor operation control.The control the permanent magnet speed of a three-phase synchronous motor using the space-vector pulse-width modulation method well be explained in this paper. This method is one of the most recent modulation methods currently used in this field. The first section deals with the synchronous motor and its working idea. In the second section, the method of embedding vectors was discussed, as it was explained and how it works. Finally, in the third section, simulation results.

articleTitle: Applying the Genetic Algorithm Concept for Determining the Inheritance Relationship between Objects in Object Oriented Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The object-oriented programming model is based on the concept of objects where data is linked to their operations within a specific classification named as a class. The class is usually used to describe a number of specific programming objects. The most important characteristic of object-oriented programming languages is the inheritance property, which is the ability to build a new class of objects on the basis of an old one that was created previously. The new class inherits all the attributes (data) and behavior (methods) of the old one without the need to reformulate or list them. This process reduces the amount of redundant data and minimizes the size of the code. However, the process of determining the common characteristics of a group of objects is often done in a traditional sequential and repetitive manner during the analysis stage of collecting and sorting different system data. Unfortunately, it's full costs of time and effort. This paper presents a proposed algorithm based on the concept of the genetic algorithm to automatically determine the inheritance relationship between the largest possible numbers of objects and thus obtaining an abstract class from which the rest of the relevant classes can inherit. The proposed algorithm can also contribute to facilitate the design of a database which consists of large data set and their link to each other.

articleTitle: Novel Approach to Energy Optimization in Relay-Assisted Device-to-Device Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, we present an approach to energy optimization in relay-assisted Device-to-Device (D2D) communication networks. Our aim is to tackle the challenge of radio resource management in order to minimize energy consumption while meeting the requirements of all users and maintaining a high Quality of Service (QoS). To achieve this, we propose a solution that effectively manages interference to ensure QoS and optimizes energy consumption through efficient resource management.This approach presents a comprehensive strategy for enhancing the performance of D2D communication networks. ‘

articleTitle: Unified Power Flow Controller in 5-Bus Power System Study and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of the Flexible Alternating Current Transmission System FACTS devices, especially on unified power flow controller (UPFC) integrates properties of both shunt and series compensations, and can effectively alter power system parameters in a way that increases power transfer capability and stabilizes the system, where it was placed in the electric grid 5-Buses focuses, in order to test the effect of his ability to control the transmitted power between the stations and also ability to install efforts, it was presented the results of the network with and without UPFC, using MATLAB program, where proved results capacity to control his ability and install efforts.

articleTitle: Modeling and experimental investigation on the performance of a PV panel with water cooling system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of the water-cooling system on PV module performance is experimentally and theoretically examined, under Derna City climate conditions. A heat transfer area of circular tubes made of copper is carefully attached to the PV back side, where a certain amount of water is induced and a set of experimental tests is thereby facilitated. A mathematical modeling to foresee the electrical performance of a PV with a water-cooling system and PV module is developed via MATLAB code. The developed model results are then validated against their corresponding data from the performed experiment. The results indicate good agreement between the experiment and the modeling. The study concluded that, with the current water-cooling system in place, the higher electrical efficiency of approximately 1.25% is figured out, which is attributed majorly to a reasonable reduction in PV cell temperature.

articleTitle: Photon Coincidence Simulation Through a Random Splitting of Virtual Photon Timestamps
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The single-photon nature and the purity of emitted photons from a light source can be quantified using the second-order correlation function, g<sup>(2)</sup>(τ). Here, we present simulation results that show how the photon coincidence time window, a characteristic of the utilized photodetection system, affects g<sup>(2)</sup>(0) for dummy photon timestamps digitally generated at constant emission rates. We use a two-channel virtual interferometer with a beam splitter controlled by a uniform random number selection. We find that g<sup>(2)</sup>(0) remarkably and quickly squeezes towards the maximum value of a chaotic light photon correlation as the coincidence time window widens. In contrast, tuning the coincidence time window close to the emitter emission decay time yields a coincidence probability of slightly less than one, an antibunching property of light. These simulation findings can participate in improving measurements of quantum light emitters’ coherence functions and revealing the degree of their photon emission purity.

articleTitle: Carrier Aggregation in 5G Technology By Integrate mmWave Range and C Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Mobile broadband services are undergoing a period of dramatic growth causing a tremendous increase in data traffic. 5G NR extends the capabilities originally defined in NR to increase data throughput by using a combination of new technologies, like Carrier Aggregation (CA), massive Multi In- put Multi Output (MIMO) techniques, beamforming and mmwaves. CA is one of the most significant 5G features that combine multiple Component Carriers (CCs) across an available spectrum to create a wider bandwidth channel for increasing the network data throughput and overall capacity.in this paper Used the CA technique by Integrated between mmwave range and C band and analyzing the planning performance (throughput, capacity, and coverage) which includes some parameters and find out the effect of CA, by conducting radio propagation using system level simulation using Atoll, for different CA scenarios of a selected high traffic area in Tripoli city, Libya .The value of the throughput when using the carrier aggregation frequency is the best, followed by the non-carrier aggregation frequency of 28 GHz, and then at the 3.5 GHz frequency. On other hand the coverage by signal level, it is found that the value of signal level -80 dBm for CA of 76.11 % and for non-carrier aggregation with 100 MHz of 3.5 GHz is 63.16 %. when frequency 28GHz with a bandwidth of 400MHz that shows coverage is 10.38%. Also it is found that the percentage of connected user on carrier aggregation mechanism is 99.9 % and for non-carrier aggregation with a bandwidth of 100 MHz at a frequency of 3.5 GHz is 93.6%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Scientific Publication of Libyan State: A Bibliometric Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper provides a detailed bibliometric analysis of the Libyan State’s scientific publications (Libya). The study is based on data from the well-known Scopus database. The study spans the years 1948 to 2022. The study examines the growth of annual publications and citations. It has been demonstrated that over the last five years, 36% of total publications and 66% of total citations have been achieved. Science mapping activities such as co-occurrence and co-citation networks were used to reveal thematic clustering and research topic trends. The top source title with the most articles is the 2021 1ST MI-STA conference, which has 142 articles. The LANCET journal is the most frequently cited locally, with 1181 articles citing it, and the most prolific author is Dr. ElHadi from the University of Tripoli with 76 articles.

articleTitle: 60 GHz Printed Yagi-Uda Beam-Deflector Integrated Refractive Index Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: An approach for deflection of the main radiation of the end-fire dipole antenna in a specific direction by changing the effective constitutive parameters of metamaterials are introduced. The concept of this phenomenon is creating a new medium that has different characteristics, in front of the electromagnetic waves to enforce it to propagate in a specific direction. This act has been done by embedding Modified Gradient Refractive Index Metamaterial (MGRIM) unit-cells (UCs) in front of the dipole-printed antenna. However, by changing the load dimensions of MGRIM, the permittivity and permeability of unit cells are going to change. Because the refractive index (n) of the medium changed, the phase of entered EM waves to this medium will be changed. So, the aim here is to create a new medium with different properties to provide a proper phase shift to tilt the end-fire radiation pattern. The challenge in this approach is are provide a high tilting beam angle, high gain, and low side lobe level simultaneously. Two unit cells are used in this paper to provide a high deflection angle and keep a high gain with a low side lobe level. First one to get medium has a gradient refractive index. The second one uses as a band stop structure in order to minimize the side lobe level (SLL) and enhance the gain. The simulation results show that by using the nonperiodicity arrangement of MGRIM UCs in front of a dipole-printed antenna, the main beam of the radiation pattern in the E-plane can be tilted 43<sup>o</sup>in the end-fire direction at 60 GHz. The proposed design exhibits an increasing gain of about 2.7dB and reduces the side lobe level to -11.2dB.

articleTitle: Generating User Interface by Composing Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Rapid development of technology allows the organizations to work on the interactive environments in any work and to co-operate on it to achieve its their goal. Therefore, we tried to solve the problem of designing proper, strong, and adequate UIs, satisfying the user and meeting his requirements. In this work, we propose to generate the user interface by creating three different types of models. These models are Dialogue model, Presentation model and Application model.

articleTitle: Double loops control of fuel cell inverter with a MDSC based-PLL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Grid-tied renewable and alternative energy technologies have become vital players in the energy industry as they contribute to clean, cost-effective, and sustainable electricity production. They require power converters and proper control to ensure their effective integration into the grid. This investigation focuses on the grid-tied fuel cell inverter control. The control scheme uses outer and inner control loops to regulate the current and the voltage. The fuel cell inverter and grid are synchronized using a multiple delayed signal cancellations (MDSC)-based PLL. The system modelling and simulation are completed using Matlab (SimElectrical). The considered fuel cell inverter is modelled to convert 150 kW DC operating at 1 kV to 130 kW/ 413 V. Harmonics generated from switching power electronic devices inside the 3-level NPC inverter are mitigated using an LCL filter. The findings indicate that the adopted control scheme performs well, with the MDSC-based PLL providing faster and more accurate frequency and phase responses than the classical PLL.

articleTitle: An Enhanced HMAX Model to Improve Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A new approach is proposed within this paper to accelerate the process of a biologically inspired Hieratical Model and X (HMAX), which is a biologically stimulated method, this model has been an efficient procedure for object recognition. Object recognition is beneficial in numerous applications such as driverless cars, and security systems. However, patches in HMAX are extracted randomly, causing in production redundant and uninformed extracted patches. Also, there is not any mechanism to evaluate them, these play a big challenge step for achieving high recognition accuracy. This paper presents a technique for selecting specific kinds of features of an image established on a Shi-Tomasi Corner Detector. A proposed approach is applied to the Caltech5 dataset. In the training stage, 70% of images are used. The results appear significant achievements in object recognition accuracies.

articleTitle: A Framework of Information Systems Reference Model for Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Significant developments in technology contribute to major transformations in all aspects of life. Information technology is a powerful tool for improving performance in institutions. However, institutions face challenges in implementing suitable information technology to achieve business objectives. There is an argument that the importance of Business/Information Technology Alignment (BITA) is critical for organizations to improve the business value of IT. Many studies have been conducted on how to achieve business and information technology alignment through some solutions, such as the reference model or the reference architecture, which have achieved great success in many areas, including banking services, healthcare, and the telecommunications industry. In comparison, the studies that dealt with institutions of higher education did not provide a complete solution to this issue. This paper proposed a framework for developing an information system reference model for higher education institutions by combining the business process management (BPM) life cycle according to the Mathias tool and the enterprise architecture tool (TOGAF ADM). This paper describes how to develop a reference model for a university to solve the incompatibility between IT and business strategy problems and move from Industry 3.0 to Industry 4.0 by enabling the technology of Industry 4.0. The proposed model will be implemented in a case study at the Faculty of Information Technology, University of Benghazi.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Single Precision Floating-point Arithmetic Logic Unit for RISC Processor on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The main purpose of conducting this research is to design and implement a single precision floating-point arithmetic logic unit (ALU) that considered as a part of the math coprocessor. The main advantage of floating-point representation is that it can support more values than fixed-point and integer representations. Summation, Subtraction, multiplication and division are arithmetic functions in these calculations. In this floating-point unit, input must be provided in IEEE-754 format, which is 32 single precision floating point values. The application of This arithmetic unit is located in the math coprocessor. Commonly referred to as reduced instruction set computation (RISC) processor. In this processor, for a signal processing, a value with high accuracy is required and as it is an iterative process, the calculation should be as fast as possible. A fixed-point and integer central processing unit (CPU) can't meet the requirements. The floating-point representation can calculate very large or very small process quickly and accurately. The system designed, verified and implemented with Verilog hardware description language using Intel Altera software tools.

articleTitle: Tracking Control of Adaptive MIMO Nonlinear Systems Using Fuzzy Logic Control and Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents two different control techniques for tracking an output reference signal to any unknown parameter vector. The two techniques are implemented to perform adaptive control approach for MIMO nonlinear systems. The first technique is fuzzy logic control (FLC). In FLC the appropriate approximation can be established based on the number of membership functions. The designed FLC-based controller will make the system outputs follow the reference input signals. The second technique is called an extreme learning machine (ELM). The ELM is a newly developed learning algorithm for generalized single-hidden-layer neural networks, where the output weights are calculated computationally and the hidden node parameters are produced at random. This work focuses on decreasing the control energy in conjunction with reducing the overall MSE, which makes the output tracks the reference input smoothly.

articleTitle: A Simulation-Based Analysis Study of Different Data Centers’ Networks Employing MPLS technique as a Fault Tolerance Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents a simulation analysis study for different data center networks employing MPLS technique as a fault tolerance mechanism to ensure availability via a backup paths. However, to illustrate the efficiency of using MPLS, each data center (namely: Fat Tree, Diamond, DCell, c-Through) is built with two scenarios networks one with MPLS and another without MPLS, so 8 scenarios are evaluated. In each scenario, the servers are used to run the applications (FTP, HTTP, VoIP and database, hence, VoIP, HTTP, FTP, and database applications are used to evaluate the performance of different data center networks.

articleTitle: A framework for improving the process of potential faults detection at the design coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Design testing is a critical process because it includes a mechanism to ensure that software systems are designed in such a way that their subsequent implementation is correct, especially with regard to the coupling of those software components. A number of studies have been conducted to introduce methods and techniques to improve the software testing process, which will positively affect its quality. However, the focus on testing couplings is still not done enough, which can help bugs propagate unpredictably faster. As a result, this paper proposed a simplified framework that allows software developers to track the likelihood of potential faults appearing, through a structured mechanism that encourages focus on this dilemma, as well as being supportive and complementary to various validation and testing processes by focusing on design coupling tests.

articleTitle: Integrating Cloud and Fog Technologies with IoT to Create Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Not long ago, there was a move from traditional farming to smart farming, which depended on data and communication technologies to boost crop output and quality. One of the main technologies that have contributed to the existence of smart agriculture is the Internet of Things (IoT). The Internet of Things technology faced many challenges, so cloud computing was proposed as a complement, yet there were some shortcomings. Fog computing technology was introduced to overcome the shortcomings of integrating the Internet of Things and cloud technology. This paper defines and studies IoT, cloud and fog technologies. They are utilized to implement a smart agricultural system consisting of three layers interacting with each other to manage, monitor, and control the agricultural environment. The implemented system has been deployed and tested on a small farm, which can be controlled remotely to observe the humidity of the soil and notify the user of any hazard, such as fire.

articleTitle: Energy Access Assessment Report Focusing on Energy Poverty and Energy Demand for Rwanda
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This technical report is a researched document that examines energy access in Rwanda, focusing on energy poverty assessment and energy demand assessment. The key findings and observations can help mitigate the energy access problems and improve access to modern energy in Rwanda. Studies have shown that sub-Saharan African countries have poor access or no access to modern energy, Rwanda being part of sub-Saharan Africa also has Poor access to modern and clean energy. To carefully study these energy access problems and proffer solutions to increase energy access in Rwanda based on realities in today’s Africa, (where most households fall below poverty lines, with social issues, low Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) and Gross Domestic Power (GDP)), an assessment of these energy problems is done based on Energy Poverty Assessment (EPA) and Energy Demand Assessment (EDA) Composite Multidimensional Indicators (CMDI), respectively. Based on the findings of this research, non-poor energy households increased their energy consumption by 29.26% to 0.68 billion kWh. The clean cooking gas usage in Rwanda is very low at 2.1%, The 2016 estimated electricity consumption is 0.5273 billion kWh, growing by 57.41% to 0.83 billion kWh for energy-poor households in 2021, compared to 52.6% predicted by International Energy Agency (IEA). Finally, there is a direct relationship between energy access and economic development including quality of life, standard of living, per capita income, urbanization, modern infrastructure, etc. Thus, the key findings and observations in this research report will improve economic and infrastructural development in Rwanda, if implemented.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of High-Resolution Direction of Arrival Estimation Based on Music Algorithm With Impact of Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This research paper used the MATLAB software for preview of the Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation based on Multiple Signal calcification (MUSIC) algorithm. Abone on The estimation of the direction of arrival of the signal has been investigated and compared for several types of uniform array configurations, including linear and orbicular, with and without mutual coupling. The Modified Root Pisarenko (MRP) technique was used to evaluate how the mutual coupling affected the precision of the (DOA) estimation using (MUSIC) algorithms.

articleTitle: A Control-Based Model of IPMSM with Hysteresis Current Control PWM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper presents an electric circuit model of an IPMSM which is based on the 90-degree torque angle vector control method. The electrical and mechanical characteristic equations of an IPMSM are modeled with one electric circuit. The model is simple yet accurate. It is tested for speed control with the hysteresis current control pulse width modulation (HCC PWM) technique. This method of controlling the current is one of the most popular methods due to its simplicity and ease of implementation. The HCC PWM is well explained in this paper using op-amps and SR flip flops. The motor model and its control are simulated in Power Simulation environment and show good and fast performance in tracking the commanded speed and load torque.

articleTitle: Control of process parameters of two-sided irradiation of electron beam in radiation technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: A semi-empirical (SE) model based on a cylindrical approximation of the target energy transfer region from an individual electron was implemented by the authors in a previous work. It has been established that the use of such an approximation leads to a significant error in the values of depth-dose (DD) curve at shallow depths in the target. This significantly limits the possibilities of using this model for selecting and controlling irradiation parameters in radiation sterilization.In this paper, we use an approximation of the energy transfer region in the form of a cone. This type of approximation makes it possible to eliminate the revealed shortcomings of the previous SE model. However, in this case, the integral transformations, which make it possible to calculate DD curves for various electron incidence angles, have a singular kernel. Singularity regularization algorithms have been developed and software has been implemented for calculating DD curves at various angles of incidence of the electron beam (EB) on the target. The created SE model makes it possible to control the parameters of the process of two-sided EB irradiation during radiation sterilization.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine MPPT Based on Intelligent Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The advancement of wind energy as a source of renewable energy is accelerating worldwide, leading to the increasing use of wind turbines because of their potential to generate large amounts of electricity. Recent advances in this field have led to better meeting the demand for electricity. This paper presents work on wind turbine modeling and simulation using MatLab/Simulink software and analysis of simulation results under various weather conditions. A fuzzy logic based tracking control is presented and applied to maximize the amount of wind energy produced.

articleTitle: Suppression of Mobile Phone Radiation in Human Head Using Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of radio frequency waves emitted by cellular phone antennas on the human head by using a 3D human head model to assess the specific absorption rate (SAR) in various human tissues. The simulation of SAR was performed using a PIFA (Planar Inverted-F Antenna) modelled in HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator) operating in the cellular frequency bands. To reduce the electromagnetic coupling between the mobile phone antenna and the human head, metamaterials were inserted at various locations in the vicinity of the antenna and study the effects of the metamaterial on the SAR level. The SAR in the human head was reduced by positioning the metamaterial between the PIFA antenna and the human head, with the metamaterial operating at a scale smaller than the wavelength of the antenna's operating frequency. The metamaterial structures exhibit resonance through internal capacitance and inductance, and a stop band was designed to align with the antenna's operating frequency band.

articleTitle: Strongly Coupled Magnetic Resonance based Wireless Power Transfer System for Implantable Medical Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The paper primarily investigates the power transfer efficiency (PTE) of a wireless power transfer (WPT) system for implantable medical devices. The intended WPT is based on strongly coupled magnetic resonance (SCMR) method, where the key emphasis is to maximize the PTE instead of minimizing the power consumption of implants. The operating frequency is planned at 13.56MHz, which is well indicated for the industrial, scientific, and medical band (ISM band). Using Keysight advanced design system (ADS) software, the prospective PTE performance was explored using a set of optimization approaches. In that, a parametric study of the WPT system was firstly introduced to preserve the optimum dimensions of system coils. Besides, an impedance matching was basically explored by tuning source and load resistors instead of expending complicated matching networks at both sides of the WPT system. Furthermore, identical transmitter-receiver coil was designed to attain a resonant frequency associating with the operating frequency. Moreover, multi-receiver coil was employed in place of a single one to inspect the potential frequency bandwidth alongside the PTE. Eventually, multi-transmitter coil was arranged to avoid the potential misalignment between the transmitter and receiver coils. As a consequence, the optimum performance in terms of the PTE was estimated in range of 90.6% at a lower coupling coefficient of 0.004 indicating a further distance.

articleTitle: Study of Electromagnetic Radiation Absorption Characteristics of Heterogeneous Charcoal-Containing Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The aim of the presented research was to establish new regularities of change of electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient values in frequency range 0.7–17.0 GHz of the materials based on powdered charcoal, impregnated to the saturation by the alkaline earth chloride aqueous solution, depending on the following: 1) electromagnetic radiation frequency value; 2) charcoal type (non-activated wood charcoal, activated wood charcoal, activated coconut charcoal). These materials were heterogeneous and flexible ones. Their outside layers were made on the base of polymer plates and mashes. The studied materials inside layers were made on the base of charcoals, impregnated to the saturation by the alkaline earth chloride aqueous solution. Such components are electrical conductive ones. It has been established, that electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient values of the studied materials are more than 0.5 in frequency bands 1.45–4.0 GHz, 6.0–17.0 GHz. The minimum values of electromagnetic radiation absorption coefficient (around 0.9) have been registered in frequency band 6.5–14.0 GHz for the materials based on powdered wood charcoals. Due to these facts these materials have been classified like wideband electromagnetic radiation absorbers. They have been recommended for use in course of development of anechoic chambers for performing microwave measurements in S, X and K<inf>u</inf> bands.

articleTitle: Developing a Mobile-Based Application System to Accelerate the Efficiency of the Course Rescheduling Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Clashing on the timetable is one of the common issues at the university level. With multiple faculties inside the university and several majors, it is not impossible for at least two lecturers to clash venue/time clashing. In this paper, the rescheduling can be done through Course Rescheduling Application System (CRAS). Our algorithm is designed to overcome inefficient procedures by providing a tool that helps lecturers directly update their subject time through a mobile application. Also, the CRAS system is created to avoid another clashing after the update is conducted. We provide a friendly and clear UI/UX design to the application as well as optimize a database through the implemented checking algorithm. The feedback shows our algorithm meets the requirement to produce a solution for the current UCSI University timetabling issue. Hence, our algorithm is most effective to be implemented with an optimal solution.

articleTitle: Documents Compression based on Content Similarities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The great explosion of data processing and the reliance on information technology are results from the widespread of computers. This results in the need for huge memory for data storing and fast transmission rate. Thus, two challenges nowadays facing information technology namely reducing the required memory size to save data on storage media and reducing the required time for data exchange between computing nodes. Many techniques were developed in both directions and others are still in progress and development. In this paper a method is introduced to reduce the size of text and image documents by utilizing the similarities between adjacent bytes in the document content. The method is analyzed and assessed experimentally using MATLAB to show its capability to reduce the size of such documents. The results are then extracted and discussed.

articleTitle: Case Analysis on Fault Tolerant Computing in C programming Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Fault tolerant computing has become an important need in computer hardware design and software development to achieve high computing reliability and availability. The ‘C’ programming language was developed for systems programming. Hence it implied many fault tolerance capabilities to develop high reliable and available programs related to a computer system. This paper provides a case study that analyzes fault models for ‘C’ programs. The case analysis presents the effects of faults in programs written in ‘C’ language. The change in program state is highlighted. The manifested errors that may lead to software failure are analyzed. Each type of those faults is described in terms of how it appears syntactically in source programs as well as how it causes an error. Fault models can help designers and developers to identify the locations in a program where such faults are likely to affect the program. The fault models are tended to be a useful foundation for fault diagnosis, mutation testing, program inspections, and verification of programs. Examples are analyzed that show the need for those model’s suitability. The paper ends with a conclusion that gives guide lines for C programmers to develop fault tolerant programs.

articleTitle: Smart Surveillance System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: With the increase in the prevalence of armed robberies and attacks in public places, an effective and reliable surveillance system has become indispensable to fulfill various security aspects and improve the quality of human life. The most common effective video surveillance system used is called closed-circuit television (CCTV), but it can be expensive, and it requires a large amount of memory. In addition to these problems, the need for manpower to detect unauthorized activities can lead to several security problems. An intelligent surveillance system (ISS) that may overcome most of the mentioned problems is proposed in this paper. This system is built with more affordable hardware components that provide automated security services more than what regular surveillance systems can offer to the user with better quality using the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Deep learning (DL), and Image Processing (IP). The obtained overall detection accuracy of 83.1% at 22.2ms helps to inform the user in a short time during the incident. Also, the classification Mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.98, 0.95, and 0.94 for detecting Knives, Guns, and Pistols, respectively, can reduce the rate of disturbing the user with false alerts.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Students’ Academic Performance Using Artificial Neural Network: A Case Study In Computer Engineering Department
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Over the past two decades, the area of educational data mining has become a hot topic in an attempt to analyse data and in predicating students’ academic performance and the overall educational institution’s quality. Traditional prediction models are usually based on conventional statistical techniques that have some limitations on providing the proper prediction model. Whereas Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques and algorithms are commonly used nowadays to predict certain outcomes based on historical data.This paper presents a study that was conducted to develop an AI model that can help in predicating early students’ academic performance in the computer engineering program at the University of Tripoli. In this study, several Machine Learning (ML) approaches and key features were used to predict students’ performance while recognizing weaknesses to improve educational outcomes. Normalized student records, for the last 25 years, at the department of Computer Engineering - University of Tripoli were used for training and testing in this research work.It is evident from the experimental results that despite the difficulty of predicting student grades, due to the inconsistent student performances, the proposed hierarchical classification approach is decently capable of predicting the future performance of students in general.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing and Allocation of Distributed Energy Resources using Genetic Algorithms: Case study of the Northern-Benghazi Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The main target is to use genetic algorithms to calculate the optimal location and size of Distributed Generation (DG) units for power distribution systems. The algorithm's flexibility allows engineers, electric utilities, and distribution network operators to efficiently integrate new DG units into their current distribution networks by making changes and modifications to locate the optimal DG unit and estimate its optimum size. The proposed method can also improve voltage profiles and reduce total real and reactive power losses. Tests conducted on a section of the Benghazi distribution system show that the decision-making algorithm has acceptable accuracy and is compared against results from NEPLAN software. With the increasing popularity of distributed energy systems worldwide, this method provides solutions to many power system problems.

articleTitle: Compact Dual Band Branch Line Coupler for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: This work describes the design of a compact size dual band branch line coupler for wireless applications. In this design, open stubs are inserted at the middle of each classical coupler arm to convert it into an equivalent T shape line. ABCD-matrix analysis are used to derive the design formulas necessary for calculating the characteristic impedances and the electrical lengths of the modified coupler arms. To attain compactness in size, stubs are 90-degree bended in the outer and the inner area of the coupler. Rectangular ground slots are added to enhance the coupler performance at the designed frequencies. The designed coupler operates at 2.45 and 5 GHz corresponding to wireless applications. Simulations are done using Ansys HFSS software on RO4003 substrate with a thickness of 0.813 mm and a dielectric constant of 3.55. Values of the simulated S-parameters show that both the isolation coefficient and the return loss are lower than -20 dB at the targeted frequencies.

articleTitle: Starting Analysis of Three-Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motors. Case Study: Oil Production Field in Libya
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In the oil fields, extracting oil and gas resources, from oil production wells and delivering them to the end destination represents fundamental process in oil industry. This depends on many factors among which a reliable source of uninterrupted electrical power supply and a set of pumps and associated equipment. Hence, analysis of its electrical power systems is necessary in order to make investigation of system reliability and to prevent change in process performance during starting in equipment such as induction motors driven pumps. During three phase induction motor starting instant the motor appears to the system as small impedance connected to a bus. It draws a large current from the system, which results in voltage drops in the system and cause disturbances to the normal operation of other system loads. Since the motor acceleration torque is dependent on motor terminal voltage, in several cases the starting motor may not be capable to arrive its rated speed due to considerably low terminal voltage. It will also directly impact on the power quality of the power system. Hence the aim of performing a motor starting study is to examine whether the starting motor can be successfully started under the operating conditions, and to see if starting the motor will seriously obstruct the normal operation of other loads in the system.In this paper, Amal oil field power distribution system. Starting of three-φ squirrel cage induction motors simultaneously were studied without drive and with variable speed drive. This has been analyzed using ETAP (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) Software.The characteristic plots, results demonstrated that connecting motors to a variable frequency drive, could be started simultaneously without causing a voltage drop in the oil field grid and oil wells attain their production without any losses.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Simulation of SAR Among Patients Using MRI Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The expanding use of electric devices in everyday life has led to an augmented interest in investigating the interaction between electromagnetic fields and biological tissues. In order to ensure the secure advancement of electromagnetic devices and avoid potential health hazards, comprehending the distribution of electromagnetic fields in the human body is imperative. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a widely accepted technique for medical diagnosis. The use of high-field MRI has become increasingly popular in recent years as it can enhance signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and image resolution, thereby decreasing acquisition time. This paper aims to investigate the impact of electromagnetic waves on the human body, particularly the specific absorption rate (SAR). Accurately calculating SAR in humans poses significant challenges and requires advanced mathematical models and computer simulations. To this end, the study utilized the Microwave Studio Transient Solver available in CST Studio Suite 2020 to solve the electromagnetic problem in different human models.

articleTitle: UAV Communications in 6G Cell-Free Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Cell-free massive multiple input multiple output (MaMIMO) is perceived as a capable solution for the induced inter-cell interference, and fair quality of service distribution among users in sixth generation (6G) networks. As well, non-terrestrial networks, and specifically unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) communications, are viewed for an integrated air-ground networks that will provide the needed coverage for rural areas and recovery services. Yet, the strong line of sight affects of the UAV links produces a challenging integration, which can be averted by exploiting cell-free structure. Hence, it is the aim of this study to describe existing literature on UAV based cell-free MaMIMO networks. The presented study will accentuate UAV use cases and 6G new technologies that will further support this integration. Future research directions and gaps are also identified.

articleTitle: Understanding the Threat Posed by Chinese Cyber Warfare Units
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The emergence of China as a global superpower has presented numerous challenges, among which is the growing threat posed by Chinese cyber warfare units. Operating under the People's Liberation Army (PLA), these units have been implicated in various high-profile cyber-attacks targeting both civilian and military entities worldwide. This paper endeavors to offer a comprehensive analysis of the risks presented by Chinese cyber warfare units, encompassing their organizational structure, tactics, and capabilities. By elucidating the nature and extent of this menace, we hope to enable governments and organizations to implement measures for better protection against Chinese cyber-attacks, as 80% of them target government bodies. In this study, we utilize the MITRE ATT&CK framework as a foundation to deliver an accessible, informative overview.

articleTitle: Comparison of IoT Architectures Based on the Seven Essential Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is expected to become one of the major technological hubs in the coming years by connecting smart physical objects and enabling a variety of applications to enable smart decision-making. This paper aims to identify and study a set of eight proposed architectures (a three-layers architecture, a five-layers architecture, SOA architecture, a 5G architecture, an Alibaba IoT architecture, an Oracle IoT architecture, and a novel IoT seven-layers architecture) for the Internet of Things. In addition, research challenges have been identified in the current trends of IoT architectures. The main contribution of this comparison paper is that it systematically reviews the current state of IoT architectures. The comparison according to the seven essential characteristics (simplicity, cost, scalability, flexibility, performance, security and privacy, and data analytic using machine learning) has been made to determine the best reference architecture that would provide an uniform basis to understand, compare, and evaluate the different solutions of IoT-based architectures.

Author Keywords: A novel unified IoT seven Layers Architecture

articleTitle: NOMA Cooperative Spectrum Sharing Average Capacity Improvement in 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: One of the most effective approaches to satisfying the requirements of the next generation of wireless services is non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA). Spectrum efficiency and average capacity are two aspects of wireless communication that have become increasingly important as the number of mobile services in use has increased. Using both traditional MIMO and Massive MIMO (M-MIMO), this study proposes two new methods for increasing the average capacity of a 5G network's downlink (DL) NOMA power domain (PD) in conjunction with a Cooperative Cognitive Radio Network (CCRN). The initial method involves NOMA users competing for available rivalry channels (R-CH) on the CCRN. The second technique creates a dedicated channel (D-CH) for NOMA users. The MATLAB program is utilized to evaluate the proposed methods in three scenarios with varying distances, power location coefficients, and transmission power. Successive interference cancellation (SIC) and unstable channel conditions are also considered while assessing the analysis of the proposed system under the assumption of Rayleigh fading. Using DL NOMA PD systems, The results reveal that the higher average capacity of best at transmit power DL NOMA with CCRN (dedicated channel) improved U4 average capacity performance by M-MIMO DL NOMA with CCRN (D-CH) improved by when compared with convention DL NOMA. Formulas in closed form were found for average capacity. The resulting formulas are verified using a Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Investigation the causes of Transformers Failures in Mellitah Complex - case study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Power transformers play a critical role in the distribution and management of electrical energy, making their reliability and longevity of paramount importance. However, transformers are susceptible to various types of failures, which can have significant impacts on power systems. A better understanding of the common causes and impacts of transformer failures, as well as methods to improve their performance, is essential for maintaining the reliability and stability of electrical power systems. The power system network of Mellitah Complex, in the "north part of Libya", experienced a number of transformer failures. In this paper, several tests and analyses have been conducted to identify the causes of failure of the transformer in the power system, and to avoid these breakdowns in the future. Also, present two case studies on unexpected failures of power transformer tag No: 40-920-ET-061B and a generator power transformer tag No: 40-910-ET-011B in the Mellitah complex during regular operation. The research is done based on the data that are gathered from several events of transformer failure and tests. The tests are; Insulation Resistance measurement test (IR), phase conductor ohmic resistance, winding resistance test, the transformer voltage ratio test, the time of oil regeneration test, dielectric strength test, IR tests conducted at 5000V for 1 minute, and voltage injection test (ratio test). The investigation showed that the main cause of the malfunction of transformer tag No: 40-920-ET-061B is the entry of water from the rusty roof into the middle HV winding. Additionally, because of not following the maintenance procedures by the maintenance team led to the mysteries of the main cause of the failure of transformer tag No: 40-910-ET-011B.

articleTitle: BER Improvement of Cooperative Spectrum Sharing of NOMA in 5G Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Non-orthogonal multiple access is one of the best methods for addressing the needs of 5G wireless services (NOMA). The proliferation of mobile devices in recent years has increased the importance of cooperative spectrum sharing and utilization in wireless communication due to increases in the bit error rate (BER) brought on by collisions and interference. In this study, MIMO and Massive MIMO (M-MIMO) in the downlink (DL) NOMA power domain (PD) in conjunction with the Cooperative Cognitive Radio Network are proposed as two new ways for improving and evaluating BER in the 5G network (CCRN). Customers of NOMA compete for available channels on the CCRN in this first strategy. The second approach creates a dedicated channel for NOMA users. Three scenarios with varying distances, power location coefficients, and transmission power are used to evaluate the proposed methods in the MATLAB software program. It is assumed that four users will share a 90 MHz BW using QPSK modulation in all three scenarios. When evaluating the performance of the suggested system under the presumption of frequency-selective Rayleigh fading, concurrent interference cancellation (SIC) and unstable channel conditions are also considered.

articleTitle: The Effect of PEMFC on Power Grid Using Advanced Equilibrium Optimizer and Particle Swarm Optimisation for Voltage Sag Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Due to the integration of various distributed generation resources into power systems, in particular, the integration of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), the electrical power grid (EPG) becomes more comprehensive and has power quality (PQ) issues like voltage/current unbalance, harmonics, voltage sag, etc. The issue of voltage sag arises from sudden changes in the EPG operating conditions. In this paper, the Advanced Equilibrium Optimizer (AEO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are proposed as solutions for EPG disturbance in partially voltage sag issues caused by three fault scenarios: single line-to-ground faults (SLGF), double line-to-ground faults (DLGF), and three line-to-ground faults (TLGF). Both of proposed controllers are set up by applying AEO and PSO, and their preponderances are demonstrated by comparison with a conventional PI controller. The simulink model of PEMFC-EPG interconnection system is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The results of PEMFC-EPG interconnection using AEO and PSO are impressive and persuasive in terms of the voltage sag elimination.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Today, people‘s daily life is more and more dependent on face recognition technology, and the research on face recognition technology is becoming more and more thorough, making great achievements in all directions. In this paper, face recognition technology is based on a neural. The network studied by Convolution Neural Network is considered one of the best types in image classification. The model implementation is based on Python and uses a data set of 540 face images for training and testing. And the technique used in this project also yielded good results in terms of accuracy, the accuracy of these results was 100% for the 16-person dataset, 97% for the 30-person dataset, and 97% for the 2-person data set.

articleTitle: Assessing Virtual Reality Sickness in Highly Immersive Virtual Laboratory Environments : Simulator Sickness Questionnaire and Mitigation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) sickness, a common challenge among VR users, has increasingly gained attention in academic research due to its adverse side effects. The Simulator Sickness Questionnaire (SSQ) has been traditionally employed to measure simulator motion sickness; however, the extent to which it measures symptoms specifically attributable to VR sickness remains underexplored. This study investigates the applicability of SSQ in assessing VR sickness in a virtual semiconductor laboratory environment, with a focus on reducing motion sickness in VR devices. A total of 97 participants performed target selection tasks using HP Reverb G2 and Oculus Quest 2 headsets in a virtual laboratory setting. The original SSQ was revised to create a VR Sickness Questionnaire, which served as the measurement index for VR-induced symptoms. The primary objective of this research was to determine the prevalence of VR sickness and explore ways to mitigate motion sickness in VR devices. The Results indicate that the majority of VR-related side effects pertain to nausea dysfunction, with a limited number of symptoms linked to cybersickness arising from various factors. These findings hold significant implications for future studies aiming to measure and design interventions for simulator sickness in VR environments. By shedding light on the effectiveness of the SSQ for evaluating VR sickness, this study contributes to the development of improved VR experiences and technologies.

articleTitle: Epileptic Seizure Detection Using Single-Channel EEG and Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by recurrent involuntary seizures which can lead to serious injuries and death. Clinicians diagnose epilepsy by examining the electroencephalograms (EEG) of patients for seizures. However, early-stage diagnosis of epilepsy is difficult due to the labor-intensive nature of the procedure, lack of trained professionals, and inherent variability in the EEG of different patients. In this paper, we propose an automatic seizure detection system with a patient-independent approach in which the system analyzes and detects seizures in single-channel EEG from multiple patients. The system classifies an EEG instance as seizure or non-seizure based on learned features from the training set. For this task, we combine a comprehensive set of features extracted from the time, frequency, and time-frequency domains to capture information about EEG signals' amplitude, frequency, and morphology. A significant amount of experimental work has been conducted to establish the best algorithms and parameters for preprocessing, feature selection, and classification. Which achieved satisfactory results where the highest accuracy and specificity exceeded 99% through a random forest classifier and the highest sensitivity of 98.9% was achieved through the RBF-SVM classifier. We also demonstrate through comparative results that feature sets selected by the minimum redundancy maximum relevance (MRMR) algorithm outperform the ones obtained through principal component analysis (PCA). Our results indicate that an accurate, rapid, and robust automatic detection of epileptic seizures is possible; which contributes significantly to the efficiency of the epilepsy diagnosis process and the care of epileptic patients.

articleTitle: The Influence of phase-shifted Line-of-sight component with correlated-shadows Rician fading over the performance of Cell-Free Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: In this research paper, we examine an important stage in advanced mobile communication networks, namely, the channel estimation (CE) proceeding, as this proceeding influences the overall performance of advanced mobile communication networks. In particular in the innovative network architecture, namely, the cell-free grid. Thus, we examine the CE proceeding regarding the cell-free grid considering rician fading, wherein the line-of-sight direction integrates a phase-shift that simulates the users’ movement. Moreover, the performance of three estimators is studied: least-squares, non-phase-aware-minimum mean square error (NPhA-MMSE), and the proposed phase-aware-MMSE (PhA-MMSE). The mean square error metric is employed for the performance evaluation of each estimator, wherein analytical and simulated results are supplied for the proposed PhA-MMSE and the NPhA-MMSE estimators for results affirmation.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Cloud and Edgeb Computing: A Survey on Current Research Activities and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Cloud computing and edge computing are distinct architectures that process data. Cloud computing is a centralized model of computing where data is stored and processed in a remote server, while edge computing is a distributed model of computing where data is stored and processed at the network’s edge. Both models have advantages and disadvantages, making them suitable for different types of applications. This article comprehensively reviews cloud and edge computing technologies, their differences, and their applications. Cloud computing has become a popular technology for storing and processing large amounts of data, while edge computing is gaining popularity due to its ability to process data closer to the source. The article discusses the advantages and disadvantages of both technologies and their potential applications in various industries, such as healthcare, transportation, and manufacturing. The article also highlights some challenges associated with implementing these technologies, including security concerns and the need for reliable connectivity. Overall, this review provides valuable insights into the current state of cloud and edge computing technologies and their potential impact on various industries. Additionally, this article will explore the potential benefits of combining both technologies for various applications

articleTitle: Sustainable Energy Investigation For Local Resource Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The power demand rises year by year due to inhabitants rising, and shortage of the energy supply induce many developers looking out for alternative energy source and new technology to cover energy lack resources. Using the local sustainable energy clean and friendly to the environment as alternative fuels and renewable energy to mitigate the consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. The investigation aimed to optimize an approach for reducing rate of energy and some assumptions are accomplished for reasonably saving method. Explore data collected to assess the waste enthalpy for Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) from 1997 to 2009 at Aziziya city Libya. The MSW is over the coming 15 years. In addition, study for energy consumption to confirm the capacity of MSW burner can utilized for 3,250 kg/h as ability of total solid waste collected. On other side this investigation power generation (PG) by using Rankin power steam cycle can produces around 1 MW of electricity mode.

articleTitle: Data Center Tree Topology Comparison Using POX Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: Nowadays Data Center Networks (DCN) deploys the Software Defined Networking (SDN) as administration and management solutions. This architecture gives centralized management and monitoring that helps to simplify the administration and reduce the data center maintenance costs. Furthermore, redundancy is the major issue of reachability and reliability which are both impacted by data center topology. This paper investigates the performance of deploying an SDN POX controller in two different DCN tree topologies. The paper considers the binary and fat-tree topology with a different number of servers. This comparison of a tree topology is based on the traditional three-layer hierarchy of core, aggregation, and access layers. The comparison of binary and fat-tree topology was conducted by the Mininet emulator. The paper compares the performance of two tree topologies based on a POX controller with a different number of servers. This evaluation compares two three topologies of DCN using performance metrics of throughput, delay as reachability metric, and overhead as reliability metric. The results show that the fat-tree topology outperforms the binary tree based on performance metrics.

articleTitle: Data Migration from Conventional Databases into NoSQL: Methods and Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Maghreb Meeting of the Conference on Sciences and Techniques of Automatic Control and Computer Engineering (MI-STA)
abstract: The variety and velocity of data are being changed by data growth. More processors, more storage space, and more money are needed to handle a huge amount of data. Big data, as it is known, refers to the growth of data. Big data processing cannot be handled by traditional databases such as relational databases.
